description:
In crates/verify/src/x_sig.rs, SIG_HEADER is declared with #[cfg(test)] while SIG_HEADER_PREFIX (which is derived from it) is always compiled. The test helper sign_article also depends on the cfg-gated SIG_HEADER. This creates an asymmetry: production code that needs to emit the header name must either duplicate the string literal or use SIG_HEADER_PREFIX indirectly, and any refactor that changes the header name must update both constants independently.

Fix: promote SIG_HEADER to a non-cfg-gated pub(crate) constant. If it was gated to avoid dead-code warnings, add #[allow(dead_code)] or ensure it is referenced from at least one production code path (the writer side).
title: verify: SIG_HEADER constant is cfg(test)-gated while SIG_HEADER_PREFIX is not
